svg.title: Where the Pacific Northwest region reaches
svg.desc: From the Oregon–California line north to Campbell River, taking in the Willamette Valley, Puget Sound, the Fraser Valley and the east side of Vancouver Island — and inland only as far as the crest of the Cascades and the Coast Mountains. Boundary data: CEC, North American Environmental Atlas — Ecological Regions, Level III (2021), CC BY 4.0 © Commission for Environmental Cooperation.
